1.consolidated_definition: Nombre que se le da a la máquina que corta, limpia, recoge y echa la caña al vehículo que la transporta a la central.
1.en_consolidated_definition: Harvester machine or cane harvester is the name given to the machine that cuts, cleans, gathers, and loads sugarcane onto a vehicle for transportation to the central processing facility.
